parts.name: Rear Shocks (Dual)
parts.description: Twin shock absorbers, one on each side between the swingarm and the frame. They give 3.7 in of rear-wheel travel and have two-step preload adjusters.
parts.function: The springs carry the rear of the bike and the dampers control how fast the swingarm moves. The preload adjusters let a rider set the ride height for a passenger or luggage.

parts.name: Left Rear Shock
parts.function: Springs and damps the left side of the swingarm.
parts.verificationNote: Dual shocks are Honda-confirmed. Mount positions and part numbers are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Right Rear Shock
parts.function: Springs and damps the right side of the swingarm.
parts.verificationNote: Dual shocks are Honda-confirmed. Mount positions and part numbers are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.
